11.question: How many products are in each category?
11.sql:
SELECT
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
GROUP BY
  category
ORDER BY
  product_count DESC;

12.question: What is the average product price by category?
12.sql:
SELECT
  category,
  AVG(price)
FROM products
GROUP BY
  category;

13.question: How many orders has each customer placed?
13.sql:
SELECT
  c.name,
  COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.name
ORDER BY
  order_count DESC;

14.question: What quantity of each product has been sold?
14.sql:
SELECT
  p.name,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.name;

15.question: What is the average amount spent per order by each customer?
15.sql:
SELECT
  c.name,
  AVG(o.total_amount) AS average_order_amount
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.name;

16.question: Which customer has spent the most money?
16.sql:
SELECT
  c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.id
ORDER BY
  SUM(o.total_amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

17.question: Which product has sold the greatest quantity?
17.sql:
SELECT
  p.name
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY
  p.name
ORDER BY
  SUM(oi.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1;

20.question: Show each customer together with every product they ordered
20.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.name,
    p.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
ORDER BY
    c.name,
    p.name;

21.question: How many different products has each customer purchased?
21.sql:
SELECT
  c.name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products_purchased
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.name
ORDER BY
  distinct_products_purchased DESC;

22.question: How much revenue has each product generated?
22.sql:
SELECT
  p.name,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY
  p.id,
  p.name
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC;

23.question: Show the total quantity purchased by each customer
23.sql:
SELECT
  c.name,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.name
ORDER BY
  total_quantity DESC;

24.question: How many orders were placed each month?
24.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(id) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY
  month
ORDER BY
  month;

25.question: Show total order revenue for each day
25.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', order_date) AS day,
  SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY
  day
ORDER BY
  day;

29.question: Show the top 5 customers by total quantity purchased

FROM customers AS c

30.question: Show total spending by customer from highest to lowest
30.sql:
SELECT
  c.name,
  SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spending
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.id,
  c.name
ORDER BY
  total_spending DESC;

31.question: Show monthly revenue ordered from newest month to oldest
31.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
  SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY
  month
ORDER BY
  month DESC;
